FlowerPainter.Floral.Name: Flowers
FlowerPainter.Floral.shape.Tooltip: Fill the entire outline with flowing colour bands or flower islands, or choose a wreath or custom ribbon.
FlowerPainter.Floral.size.Tooltip: Size relative to the open space inside the selection.
FlowerPainter.Floral.bandWidth.Tooltip: Controls colour-band and island size in carpet modes, or ribbon width in other modes.
FlowerPainter.Floral.colorPattern.Toolti: Use separate flower materials by row, alternating sections, or one material throughout. Actual colours come from the chosen props.
FlowerPainter.Floral.shrubs.Tooltip: Carpet modes replace the last colour region with shrubs when multiple flowers are used. A single flower stays all flowers. Other modes add a shrub border.
FlowerPainter.Floral.flowerAssets.Toolti: Primary flowering props. Automatic prefers installed flower assets with vanilla fallbacks.
FlowerPainter.Floral.accentAssets.Toolti: Flowering props for the second band or alternating section.
FlowerPainter.Floral.detailAssets.Toolti: Flowering props for the third band or alternating section.
FlowerPainter.Floral.palette.Tooltip: Choose the preferred automatic flower mix; explicit flower choices take precedence.
FlowerPainter.Floral.spacing.Tooltip: Wider spacing uses fewer props. Carpet modes enlarge flower clusters to keep the ground covered; flower size also scales the spacing.
FlowerPainter.Floral.flowerScale.Tooltip: Scale each flower prop while preserving the overall design. Carpet modes adjust spacing with the size; smaller flowers need more props.
FlowerPainter.Floral.rotation.Tooltip: Rotate the geometric design or the default S curve. Hand-placed points stay in place.
FlowerPainter.Floral.controlPoints.Toolt: Place at least two points inside the area, in drawing order. Without points the preview shows an S curve. Right-click removes a nearby point.
FlowerPainter.Floral.Issue.NoRoom: Not enough clear space for this flower pattern. Make the selection larger or choose a narrower ribbon. A custom curve needs at least two points.
FlowerPainter.Floral.Issue.DensityLimite: Spacing was increased to keep the whole pattern within {0} props.
FlowerPainter.Floral.Hint.PlacePoint: Click inside the area to add the next curve point.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.PointNote: Click inside the area in order to draw the flower ribbon.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.PointBanner: Click inside the area in order · right-click removes
FlowerPainter.Floral.Issue.CarpetBudget: The entire carpet is limited to {0} props, with larger flower clusters to maintain coverage. A smaller selection preserves finer plant sizes.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.RerollTip: Regenerate gap colours while preserving each manual pattern's position, size, angle and flowers.
FlowerPainter.Floral.flowerPalette.Toolt: Select any number of loaded flower props, including installed asset packs. Each plant is a colour in the design. One selection covers the whole area; leave empty for automatic planting.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.ColorsTip: Choose the flowers used for automatic gap filling. Each pattern can also have its own flower.
FlowerPainter.Floral.motifs.Tooltip: Add multiple independent patterns, move, rotate and scale them. The selection clips anything outside.
FlowerPainter.Floral.fillGaps.Tooltip: Fill only space not covered by your patterns, preserving their position and flowers.
FlowerPainter.Floral.gapStyle.Tooltip: Automatic colour composition used when filling the remaining gaps.
FlowerPainter.Floral.Issue.AddMotif: Add a pattern or fill the gaps to continue.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.ComposeTip: Arrange pattern fragments first, then fill the gaps. The frame clips patterns without fitting them.
FlowerPainter.Floral.UI.DragHint: On the map, drag the white centre to move, green handle to scale, orange handle to rotate. Faint outside outlines show the full pattern. Right-click or Esc ends editing.
